privacy.title: PRIVACY NOTICE (KVKK)
privacy.body:
Last updated: 2 November 2026

This notice is provided under Article 10 of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") and the related Communiqué on the duty to inform. It explains how 333 Grillz processes the personal data of people who order from us, contact us or visit this website. The Turkish version is the binding one.

## 1. Data controller
- Data controller: 333 Grillz (sole proprietorship, Istanbul). The data controller's full identity is provided on request at the e-mail address below.
- E-mail: 333artisan@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +90 505 315 91 86
- Website: https://333jewelry.com

## 2. Which personal data we process
- Identity: your first and last name (for the scan appointment and delivery).
- Contact: your phone number and WhatsApp messages; your delivery address if you choose shipping; your e-mail address if you send us an .STL file.
- Order details: the products and options you choose, order number, amount, appointment date, payment and delivery status, your design approvals, and any reference photos you send.
- Intraoral digital scan: a 3D scan of your teeth (.STL file). Because it shows the structure of your teeth it may count as health data, so we protect it as special-category personal data.
- Age confirmation: your confirmation that you are 18 or older.
- Website use: our site uses no cookies and no advertising or analytics tracking. Your cart and your language and currency choices are stored only in your own browser and are not sent to us. The company hosting the site may briefly keep connection logs such as IP addresses for technical security.

The order form on the website does not ask for your name, phone number or address. The contents of your order (products, amount, scan and delivery choices) are written to our order record; you share your contact details with us yourself on WhatsApp.

## 3. Why we process it
- To take your order, check its price and stay in touch with you,
- To book and remind you of your scan appointment at our partner clinic,
- To design, cast, polish and deliver a piece made to your measurements,
- To track your payment and delivery,
- To keep a record of your design approvals, requests, complaints and questions,
- To meet our legal duties (keeping commercial and financial records),
- To protect our rights in case of a dispute.

Your personal data is never used for marketing, never sold, and never shared with third parties for advertising.

## 4. Legal grounds
- Necessary to make or perform a contract (KVKK Art. 5/2-c): order, appointment, production and delivery.
- Necessary to meet our legal obligations (Art. 5/2-ç): commercial and financial records.
- Necessary to establish, exercise or protect a right (Art. 5/2-e): evidence in a dispute.
- Our legitimate interest, provided it does not harm your fundamental rights (Art. 5/2-f): order records, price checks and website security.
- Intraoral scan data and transfers abroad: your explicit consent (Art. 6/2 and Art. 9). We ask for this consent separately before your scan; without it we cannot make a piece to your measurements.

## 5. Who we share it with
Only for the purposes above and only as far as needed:
- Our partner clinic (Bomonti, Istanbul): your name and appointment details, to book and carry out the scan. The clinic is a separate data controller for its own processing.
- Our design (CAD) service provider: only your scan file and the order contents, to design your piece; your name and contact details are not shared. This provider is located abroad.
- Casting and polishing workshops (Türkiye): only the design file and the order number.
- The courier: your name, phone number and address if you choose shipping.
- Technical service providers: WhatsApp (Meta), Google (e-mail and order record sheets) and GitHub (website hosting). Their servers may be located abroad.
- Authorised public authorities: only when the law requires it.

Transfers abroad are made in line with the conditions in Article 9 of the KVKK.

## 6. How we collect it
Partly by automated means, electronically: through the order form on our website, WhatsApp and e-mail messages, the digital scan at our partner clinic, and the files you send us.

## 7. How long we keep it
- Order, payment and delivery records: for the period set by law (10 years for commercial books and documents).
- Intraoral scan files: up to 2 years after delivery, so we can remake or repair your piece if you ask.
- WhatsApp and e-mail messages: up to 2 years after the order is completed.
When the period ends, your data is deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

## 8. Your rights
Under Article 11 of the KVKK you can ask us:
- whether your personal data is processed,
- for information about it if it is,
- the purpose of the processing and whether it is used for that purpose,
- which third parties in Türkiye or abroad it has been shared with,
- to correct it if it is incomplete or wrong,
- to delete or destroy it under the conditions in Article 7 of the KVKK,
- to inform the third parties it was shared with of any correction, deletion or destruction,
- to object to a result against you that comes only from automated analysis,
- to compensate any damage caused by unlawful processing.
You can withdraw your explicit consent at any time; this does not affect processing done before you withdraw it.

## 9. How to apply
Send your request to 333artisan@gmail.com with information that lets us confirm your identity. We answer free of charge within 30 days at the latest; if the request involves an extra cost, the fee set by the Personal Data Protection Board may be charged. If your request is refused, the answer is insufficient or we do not answer in time, you can complain to the Personal Data Protection Board.

## 10. Age limit
We only serve people aged 18 or older. If we learn that someone is under 18, we delete their data without creating an order.
